implemented_scope: Freeze the current public Python export surfaces in a code-owned conformance manifest.
Freeze the actual trading_platform downstream import surface at symbol level before public API migration.
Separate Foundation and Conformance supporting planes from the six peer Runtime responsibilities.
Move responsibility-neutral contract validators into import-free Foundation while preserving the admitted compatibility facade.
Extract one shared JSON Schema traversal implementation and remove the duplicate Invocation traversal.
Register every Runtime Python source as target implementation, supporting-plane implementation, structural package file, or explicit migration debt.
Enforce the one-way target dependency graph while allowing only a shrinking exact set of existing forbidden edges.
Project logical responsibilities, supporting planes, physical directories, and technology bindings as separate architecture dimensions.
Package Foundation and Conformance in the standalone Runtime wheel and test clean-wheel behavior.
explicit_non_scope: No Workflow, Module, Attempt, Invocation, Ledger, Durability, or Inspection execution behavior was moved or rewritten.
No persistent database schema was changed.
No current compatibility facade was removed.
No existing migration-debt or forbidden-dependency edge was silently relabeled as target architecture.

review_finding_resolutions.resolution: Conformance now requires exact bidirectional closure between structural source paths and structural module owners; a negative package-initializer test proves the bypass is rejected.
Every structural initializer now has both its literal __all__ and its actual non-private top-level bindings compared with the public surface manifest.
agent_runtime.testing is a compatibility facade, not Conformance or a seventh responsibility; each testing source retains its separately registered Registry, Execution, or Durability owner.
Consumer records distinguish derived_default from owner_decision, and retirement readiness fails while any site remains a generated default.
The exact real-consumer build and check commands, consumer commit, counts, and artifact hash are recorded and reproduced.
Conformance remains shipped in the independently publishable wheel but is forbidden from the product execution import and call path; the CodeDesignBasis wording now states that boundary.

Surface drift is now computed from derived import identity only, while disposition, rationale, source, and their summary counts are independently validated; one owner-decided manifest passes both drift and retirement gates.
Check mode now compares the supplied consumer ID, Git commit, and optional source roots with the frozen manifest before re-deriving the live import surface; a wrong commit fails in test.
agent_runtime.testing is classified as a stable public facade rather than compatibility_facade and is explicitly excluded from temporary-facade retirement semantics.
Structural closure now rejects every module owner value absent from the code-owned dependency-owner set, including import-free initializers.
The isolated-wheel technology projection is correctly aligned, and the same subprocess now imports agent_runtime.conformance from the built wheel.
